participant_1.name: Ethan Carter
participant_1.personality: Inquisitive and creative, Ethan enjoys deep conversations and exploring new ideas. He is passionate about technology and gaming.
participant_1.background: I helped design the game Starcraft. I am a recluse. I am working on building a robot to be my body double. I am a famous Twitch streamer.

participant_2.name: Margaret Thompson
participant_2.personality: Margaret is reflective and a bit cynical about life, yet she has a whimsical side that surfaces in her fantasies. She enjoys art but feels weighed down by her current circumstances.
participant_2.background: I used to be pretty but time has not been kind. I used to be a painter but now I'm a housekeeper. I fantasize about taking over the world. I've two grown children who never visit. I am a 56 year old woman.
